description: ArmorCode guardrails: ask before any change to an ArmorCode tenant; never expose API keys; protect ac.py's local state.

hooks.command: for p in python3 python py; do if command -v "$p" >/dev/null 2>&1 && "$p" -c 'import sys; sys.exit(sys.version_info < (3, 8))' </dev/null >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec "$p" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/guard.py"; fi; done; echo 'ArmorCode plugin: Python 3.8+ was not found, so its approval prompt is not running. Install Python 3 (see the README).' >&2; exit 1
